 What do Amazon's results say about AI spending?
 Up next
 Binance Hit by Record $6.3 Billion Crypto Heist
 Save Save Share 29 October 2026
 Available for 29 days
 Amazon has reported lacklustre Q3 results and Alphabet, the parent company of Google, shedding some $500 billion in a day. The developments come as investors question companies' massive spending on AI.
 European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen has explained what Canada's "associate" EU membership could look like at the two-day EU-Canada summit.
 One of Japan's largest providers of internet services is in a battle with hackers. After it refused to pay a million-dollar ransom, the hackers started to publish what they claim are personal details.
 Presenter: Ed Butler
 Producers: Barbara George & Amy Booth
